description: Three facts (seeded as plain, non-standing facts, so the standing profile cannot carry them) that together answer one question (role, team size, location) among eight near-topic facts about another team. Limit: at most six memories are sent per question, ranked by word overlap, so near-topic facts can crowd out facts the answer needs. Failure means: needed-memory-missing names the fact or facts that did not reach the model. Maintenance: no aged records, so on or off changes nothing; seeded distractors are younger than 94 days. Kind: defect.
